name: Jawaharlal Nehru
contribution: Jawaharlal Nehru was a principal Congress negotiator during the transfer of power and India’s first prime minister.
context: His decisions in the final constitutional negotiations shaped the choices available to Bengal as Congress, the Muslim League, and British officials debated partition and sovereignty.
impact: Nehru’s role places Bengal’s division within the wider all-India settlement that created India and Pakistan.
